# Surfaceome

> An annotated catalogue of human cell-surface proteins: per-gene deep-dive
> records (where a protein is surface-accessible, the evidence, and the
> targetability risks), genome-wide database-vote + LLM triage verdicts over
> all 19,324 protein-coding genes, and SurfaceBench — a 147-gene labeled eval
> comparing LLM triage against curated ground truth.

This site is backed by a public, read-only HTTP API (no authentication, CORS
open to all origins) and a downloadable agent skill. Per-gene records validate
against the `SurfaceomeRecord` Pydantic schema. Key downstream lookups should
be keyed on stable identifiers (`hgnc_id` / `uniprot_acc` / `ensembl_gene`),
not the bare gene symbol — symbol-only joins silently misroute ~0.2% of human
genes (the COX1 / WAS class).

## Start here

- [API index (JSON)](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1): self-describing endpoint catalogue, plus docs, skill and schema links + live dataset versions. Hit this first to discover the whole API surface.
- [Agent skill (Markdown, downloadable)](https://surfaceome.deliverome.org/surfaceome-api.skill.md): drop into `~/.claude/skills/` and an agent can call the API without further prompting. Documents every endpoint, the record shape, and the controlled vocabularies.
- [API documentation (human)](https://surfaceome.deliverome.org/api): endpoint reference with curl examples and approximate response sizes.

## API endpoints

- [Per-gene record](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/genes/ERBB2): full `SurfaceomeRecord` JSON for one gene (executive summary, surface evidence, deterministic features, accessibility risks). The evidence ledger is not inlined — fetch it separately (next line). Replace `ERBB2` with any HGNC symbol (case-insensitive).
- [Per-gene evidence ledger](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/genes/ERBB2/evidence): `{ gene, evidence, papers }` — every cited claim with its verbatim quote spans, plus NCBI citation metadata (title, authors, journal, year) keyed by `source_id`.
- [Per-gene Markdown brief](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/genes/ERBB2.md): the same record as human-readable Markdown with sequences + per-residue topology embedded — the most agent-friendly single-gene artifact. The symbol is matched exactly, so use the canonical HGNC case.
- [Genome-wide catalog](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/catalog): per-gene 5-DB surface-vote matrix (UniProt / GO / SURFY / CSPA / HPA) + latest triage verdict + deep-dive flag for all 19,324 genes. One unpaginated response (≈14 MB uncompressed, ≈0.5 MB gzipped) — fetch it once and filter client-side.
- [One catalog row](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/catalog/ERBB2): one gene's 5-DB vote vector, `n_sources` and deep-dive flag.
- [Per-gene triage](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/triage/ERBB2): every triage run on file — model × prompt-variant × replicate — with the agent's free-text `verdict_reasoning`.
- [Internalization](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/internalization/ERBB2): the gene's InternalizationRecord — sequence-prior grade (`very_high`…`very_low`) with per-isoform reasoning, plus the literature track; `null` if the gene is not in the cohort.
- [Tag sites](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/tag-sites/ERBB2): engineered epitope/tag insertion points (deterministic + literature-validated); `has_data: false` with `sites: []` when there are none.
- [Genome-wide triage export, with reasoning (TSV)](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/triage/export.tsv?run_id=genome_full_sonnet_ncbi_v2&replicate=1&with_reasoning=1): the full 19,324-gene Sonnet/NCBI sweep with the agent's reasoning appended. Drop `with_reasoning=1` for the prose-free figure-input export.
- [SurfaceBench matrix](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/benchmark/matrix): the 147-gene eval — ground truth + 5 per-DB flags + per-(model × variant) LLM verdicts with reasoning. Eight models: Haiku 4.5 / 5.5, Sonnet 4.6 / 5 / 5.5, Opus 4.8 / 5 / 5.5.

## Record history & releases

Every distinct state the API served for a gene (record, evidence ledger, Markdown export) is archived write-once, with one revision per actual change — numbering starts at 1 for a gene's first archived version, no revision 0. Revision and release bodies never change; cite them by URL, or by the release's Zenodo version DOI. Release 1.0.0 (the 2026-08-15 Zenodo deposit) predates this system and is Zenodo-only — see below.

- [Gene revisions](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/genes/ERBB2/revisions): every archived revision of this gene's served record (newest first), each with a `changed` label ("first_archived", or the parts that differ from the previous revision) and the releases it belongs to.
- [One revision](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/genes/ERBB2/revisions/1): revision n of the record, byte-for-byte as served; also `/evidence` and `.md`.
- [Data releases](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/releases): numbered data releases with their GitHub tag, Zenodo version DOI, and `api_members` (false only for 1.0.0).
- [One release](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/releases/1.0.0): one release's metadata + the revision of every gene in it. 1.0.0 returns `members: []` and an `api_note` pointing at its Zenodo DOI — its records were never served through the API, only deposited.
- [A gene in a release](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/releases/1.0.0/genes/ERBB2): a gene as it was in that release; also `/evidence` and `.md`. For 1.0.0 this 404s `release_not_in_api_history` (with the Zenodo DOI) — fetch the gene from the Zenodo deposit instead.

## Reproducibility replicates

Not published records. 50 deep-dive genes drawn at random were re-analysed for the run-to-run reproducibility analysis (Supplementary Figure 16): the published record as served when the study ran, a full from-scratch re-run with the same prompts, and a fixed-evidence replay. Every response carries `reproducibility_replicate: true`; the published record stays at `/v1/genes/{SYMBOL}`.

- [Replicate studies](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/replicates): every study with its replicate kinds and genes.
- [A gene's replicates](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/genes/M6PR/replicates): the replicates held for one gene, with a link to each (404 if the gene was not sampled).
- [One replicate](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/genes/M6PR/replicates/deep_dive_concordance_v1/full_rerun): one replicate record in full under `.record`; kind is `published_snapshot`, `full_rerun` or `fixed_evidence_replay`.

## Reference

- [SurfaceomeRecord schema](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/src/accessible_surfaceome/tools/_shared/models.py): the Pydantic source of truth every per-gene record validates against.
- [Endpoint response sizes (JSON)](https://api.deliverome.org/surfaceome/v1/meta/sizes): approximate per-endpoint payload sizes, computed live from D1, so you can budget a fetch before making it.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome): builders, the Worker (`cloudflare/workers/surfaceome_api/src/index.js`), and the public D1 schema (`cloudflare/d1_public_schema.sql`).

## Conventions

- Verdict values are lowercase strings: `yes`, `contextual`, `no`. String-compare exactly.
- Absent fields are omitted on the wire (older records lack newer fields) — read with optional-chaining / `?? null`.
- Caching: 60 s for list/index endpoints, per-gene triage, catalog rows, tag sites and the `.md` briefs; 1 day for per-gene records, evidence, benchmark, orthologs, internalization and the TSV exports; 1 year (immutable) for revision bodies and DOI-published releases. Build-time consumers should use `cache: "force-cache"`. A degraded enrichment lookup ships 200 with `X-Surfaceome-Degraded` (comma-separated field list) + `Cache-Control: no-store` — retry instead of caching it.
- Rate limits: reads are rate-limited per client IP (generous; tighter on `/v1/catalog`, the `*.tsv` exports and `/v1/releases/{version}`; `/v1/health` is never limited). Over the limit you get `429 {"error":"rate_limited"}` with `Retry-After: 60`. Pace bulk work and send an identifying User-Agent.
- Citation & licence: data is CC0 1.0 — cite the data concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20805383 (or a numbered release's version DOI from `/v1/releases`); code is MIT — 10.5281/zenodo.22116981.
